samples.summary: Go infector + GravityRAT GX: fix API/OUI claims; identify RAT

Go infector: main.visit at VA 0x62c450 writes mutated replicas with generation marks; get_self_mutated_bytes at 0x62cf80 decodes an embedded managed image and appends padding.
plant_start_up at 0x62cba0 writes randomized copies; add_startup at 0x62cae0 registers Run-key activation.

The reported Mono.Cecil member at 0x2ca8cf is a Base64 LSASS executable. Raw LSASS copies begin at 0x599e08, 0x64f655 and subsequent offsets; actual Mono.Cecil DLLs begin at 0x5f5440 and subsequent offsets.
Carved 660480-byte LSASS executable SHA256 1c0ea462f0bbd7acfdf4c6daf3cb8ce09e1375b766fbd3ff89f40c0aa3f4fc96 exactly matches Talos published GravityRAT GX.
CIL resolves Cecil in Program.myAssembler; AES belongs to data handling, not an encrypted reflective executable chain.

CIL DriveInfo.GetDrives and USB event handling call GetFiles; UploadManager sends the collected paths through WebClient.UploadFileTaskAsync. DoViaCmd sets a hidden window, runs cmd.exe /c with output redirection, then uploads command output.
Mach-O loader: Universal x86_64/arm64 loader; static disassembly and Unicorn arithmetic emulation only, with host API calls intercepted and AppleScript execution bypassed.
Instrumentation, parent/process and hardware checks alter a key word; elapsed inspection time over 50 ms corrupts it.
Self __text SHA256 participates in the 36-byte PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 password; 0x178de iterations and a reconstructed 32-byte salt derive an AES-256-GCM key.
Bypassing environment checks recovered and authenticated the encrypted blocks, assembling a 265168-byte run-only AppleScript (SHA256 923507c260f3f28d0b31337d1cc84a90dff97d9d9fc145ba9ac08ab5271b96e3).

OSA source is stripped; decoded constant tables contain Keychains, Safari Cookies, logins.json, Chrome, AWS/gcloud credentials, shell history, curl, archive and launchctl staging. These corroborate the existing stealer loader identity; no blanket family rename to AMOS.
Parite/PCRat: Parite graft at RVA 0x2e000 decrypts 0x598 bytes backward using DWORD XOR key 0x432266. Decoded loader begins at VA 0x42e1a8.

Decoded loader references PINF, Initiate and the appended body offset 0x2c1dc; decrypting the 0x2b000-byte body yields a PE DLL (SHA256 f0fd8a9f0741b251bff9b4a5b22ce7e8d95450472e93c353582a708638e865f2).
Embedded Server.dll SHA256 c79ec2df0eaf43e3d1cf4d9e1550e8f23609b32bee0aede900f3a74b0ec73b65 retains PCRat Update/PCRatStact.

Server disassembly calls BitBlt at 0x1000b8c4, installs a global WH_GETMESSAGE hook at 0x10008c06, and creates remote threads at 0x10007a34. Existing capture/hook co-occurrence description does not claim a keyboard logger.

changes.removed: Unsupported unsigned-decryptor-reflection-entrypoint verdict; its required APIs remain individually detected by their canonical neutral traits.
changes.relocated: Seven raw virtualization OUI references and their union move from VM-evasion objectives to network/interface at notable. All patterns and file-type gates retained; non-behavioral evasion mappings and context downgrades removed.
changes.consumers: Two exact MAC-union consumers updated; DMI vendor selector preserves the union alternative. Five network-interface consumers enumerate the preexisting 61 IDs to preserve needs cardinality and avoid treating seven OUI labels as seven queried APIs. Broader VM/obfuscation objective selectors intentionally cease selecting the unsupported signals.
changes.added: Four independent GX fingerprint atoms and one hostile family composite; section/size scoped, no filename, C2 host, version number or file hash required.

controls.near_misses: Each of four required fingerprint strings independently replaced at equal byte length; all four fail the GX composite.
controls.benign_control: Standalone unmodified Mono.Cecil and Mono.Cecil plus an OUI table: zero hostile/suspicious; the table does not activate either host-information API-count composite.
controls.fixture_provenance: Positive carved at 0x599e08, length 660480; benign library carved at 0x5f5440, length 280576 from first sample. Equal-length literal mutations and appended OUI labels create controls; sample code never executed.

limitations: Sandbox and Bazaar pages were inaccessible to the web tool; supplied labels were treated as provenance, not independent behavioral proof. No fetched-package PURL is associated with these embedded resources.
